$description: Three open-licensed faces, self-hosted via @fontsource. Fallbacks matter: they are what renders before the webfont resolves.

font-sans.$description: Body copy and interface text. The document default.

mpc.use.en: Body copy and interface text. The document default.

mpc.role.en: Sans — body copy and interface text.

font-display.$description: Headlines and figures. Always with -0.02em tracking via .font-display.

mpc.use.en: Headlines and figures. Always with -0.02em tracking via .font-display.
mpc.use.ko: 헤드라인·수치. 항상 .font-display를 통해 자간 -0.02em과 함께 사용합니다.

mpc.note.en: Falls back to Inter, not a system serif — a headline that loses its webfont should still look like this site.
mpc.note.ko: 시스템 세리프가 아닌 Inter로 폴백합니다 — 웹폰트 로드에 실패한 헤드라인도 이 사이트처럼 보여야 하기 때문입니다.

mpc.role.en: Display — headlines, the wordmark, and figures.

font-mono.$description: Eyebrow labels and data. Never body copy.

mpc.use.en: Eyebrow labels and data. Never body copy.

mpc.role.en: Mono — eyebrow labels (11px, 0.18em tracking, uppercase) and data.
